activities.activity_description: Remove dependencies on fabric/comm, fabric/protoutil, pkg/errors, and their transitive dependencies from the statebased package. Ensure the only fabric imports are the protos.
Remove fabric packages and their transitive dependencies from the entities package.
Update the marbles02_private chaincode documentation and scripts in fabric-samples to add `tr -d '\n'` to the export expressions to prevent JSON parsing errors.
Move protoutil utilities into fabric-lib-go and update the main Fabric repository to use the externalized version.
Move BCCSP code into fabric-lib-go and update the main Fabric repository to use the externalized version.
Move MSP code into fabric-lib-go and update the main Fabric repository to use the externalized version.
Move discovery client code into fabric-lib-go and update the main Fabric repository to use the externalized version.
Update the Fabric Go SDK to remove internal copies of protoutil, BCCSP, MSP, and discovery client, and instead use the externalized packages from fabric-lib-go.
Perform integration testing across Fabric, fabric-lib-go, and the Fabric Go SDK to ensure all externalized packages and refactored components work correctly. Update CI pipelines as needed.
